name: Channel Magic
text:
A `WIZARD` can channel magic to generate or upgrade ability dice to be used for magical abilities. When making the Channel action, you may add a new [Double] with a value of 3 to your ability dice, or choose one existing ability dice and apply one of the following effects to it:
- Upgrade a [Double] to a [Triple], or a [Triple] to a [Quad].
- Increase the value of an ability dice by 3 (to a maximum of 6).

Then, you must roll 2D6 and consult the Magical Calamity table:
- **2: Calamitous Detonation.** Allocate 5 damage points to each fighter within 3" of the `WIZARD`. Then, the `WIZARD` is taken out of action.
- **3–4: Miscast.** Allocate 5 damage points to the `WIZARD`. The Channel action ends and no ability dice are added or upgraded.
- **5–9: Barely Contained Power.** Allocate 3 damage points to the `WIZARD`.
- **10–12: Controlled Channeling.** The `WIZARD` suffers no ill effects.

The channeled ability dice must be used for a magical ability during the `WIZARD`'s activation; they cannot be saved for another fighter and are discarded if unused. A `WIZARD` can channel magic multiple times for the same ability dice (e.g., a [Double] can first be upgraded to a [Triple], and then have its value increased).

name: Rush
text: Add 1 to the Move characteristic of this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Onslaught
text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic for this fighter's next melee attack action this activation.

name: Careful Aim
text: Add 1 to the Shoot characteristic of this fighter for its next ranged attack action this activation.

name: Aura of Resistance
text: *Magical ability*. Until the end of the battle round, add 2 to this fighter's Armour characteristic.

name: Respite
text: A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter. Remove D3+3 damage points from this fighter.

name: Arcane Blast
text: *Magical ability*. Select a visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter and roll a dice. On a 3+, allocate (X) damage points to that fighter.

name: Dispel Wyrd
text: *Magical ability*. Select a [double], [triple] or [quad] from your opponent's ability dice. Roll a dice, and add the (X) of this ability to the roll. On a 7+, that [double], [triple] or [quad] is discarded.

name: Inspiring Presence
text: Select a visible friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter that has not activated yet this battle round. You can activate that fighter immediately after this fighter's activation ends.

name: Rampage
text: This fighter makes a free move action up to (X)". Then, they can make a free attack action.

name: Strike Them Down
text: A fighter can make this reaction when a visible enemy fighter within 1" of them makes a retreat action. Roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate D6 damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Take Cover
text: A fighter that is in cover can make this reaction after they are targeted by a ranged attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Count one critical hit from that attack action as a hit instead.

name: Counter
text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. If there are any unmodified hit rolls of 1, allocate 2 damage points to the attacking fighter. In addition, if there are 2 or more hit rolls from that attack action that miss, allocate 1 damage point to the attacking fighter.
